children: Compass Group's strong end to the year is a clear positive that stands out from full-year results broadly in line with expectations, UBS writes. The British catering services company expects organic revenue growth of around 7% in fiscal 2027, with a high-single-digit rise in underlying operating profit. The forecasts for the year ahead are in line with expectations, UBS notes. Compass announced plans to return up to $1.5 billion via buybacks over the next two years, which should also help the company's stock, the Swiss bank adds. Shares are up 3.7%. (michael.hennessey@wsj.com)
